parameters.note: Salmon Lake (the Lower Salmon Lake of the Gold Lakes Basin, Sierra Co.; site of Salmon Lake Lodge; GNIS 263044) is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document does not list this lake (only 'Salmon Lake, Upper' is listed), so no stocking schedule is recorded here.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
